name: movie_procyon_b_lpqi_orm
label: Movie: Procyon B's diameter on the five-telescope LPQI network with the final instrument (R = 10 000 spectrograph, 10 ps array)
notes: Procyon B (V 10.7, DQZ, R 0.01234 Rsun at 3.51 pc: 32.7 uas) on the ten NOT/TNG/GTC/WHT/INT pairs with the R = 10 000 array; dec +5.2 keeps it above 30 deg for 8 h.

glare_fraction 0 here as the comparison case; Procyon A (V 0.34) is 2.5-6 arcsec away and 10.4 mag brighter, so its aureole is in reality a larger fraction of B's light than Sirius A's is of Sirius B's (campaign option --set options.glare_fraction=3 for that case).
